INSERT INTO interpro_entry_metadata (
            data_source_id, interpro_id, entry_type, name, short_name, description
        )
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
        ON CONFLICT (interpro_id) DO UPDATE
        SET
            name = EXCLUDED.name,
            short_name = EXCLUDED.short_name,
            description = EXCLUDED.description,
            updated_at = NOW()
